description: Admin agents and owners. Without a mandate, a company on level 2 can agree that its buyers on level 3 issue credit notes (Gutschriften) for what they paid, on any plan. get, sign (challenge, then agreement_proof), revoke (at the end of the month).

action.description: get shows the agreement and whether it is signed, sign signs it (a challenge first), revoke ends it at the end of the month

agreement_proof.description: sign, second call: the challenge message the first call returned, and your wallet's signature over it

confirm.description: sign: true, after you read the agreement from get

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one
